name: page2ai-mcp
description: Convert any web page to clean Markdown for LLM context
long_description:
Page2AI MCP converts a web page URL to Markdown for AI context windows. It keeps the page's main content (its <main> or dominant <article>), preserves code blocks with language hints, converts tables and lists, and drops navigation, headers, footers and sidebars. The only network requests go to the URL you pass it and the addresses it redirects to, asked for as a browser opens a page, so docs platforms return the page itself rather than a Markdown copy of it: pure Node + linkedom, no external services, no telemetry.

Agent Bridge: when the Page2AI browser extension is connected, the tool routes through the user's real browser — cookies, JavaScript rendering, extension-quality extraction — so pages behind a sign-in and JS-rendered content are within reach. Without the bridge, a page behind a sign-in or rendered only by JavaScript is out of the tool's reach; pass its HTML directly via the `html` parameter.

Companion to the Page2AI browser extension (https://github.com/igorsaevets/page2ai-extension), which converts the live page in your own browser, including pages behind a sign-in. Built on the open-source @page2ai/core library.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a web page URL, or take HTML you already have, and convert it to clean Markdown. Preserves headings, code blocks, links, and tables; keeps the main content and drops navigation, headers, footers, and sidebars. A fetch carries no cookies and runs no page scripts; with Agent Bridge on in the Page2AI browser extension, URLs open in your own browser instead.
